title: Assonance, Consonance, and Alliteration — Figures of Speech and Sound Devices
skills: identify repeated vowel and consonant sound patterns
analyze how sound devices create rhythm and emphasis
explain how sound patterns contribute to tone and poetic effect
alignment_note: Compares assonance, consonance, and alliteration as distinct sound devices and shows how repeated sound patterns shape rhythm, emphasis, and poetic effect. Supports poetry analysis, sound-pattern recognition, author's craft, and evidence-based interpretation across high school English courses.
